 Detroit News Powerball numbers for Wednesday's drawing
 The Detroit News Updated Thu, November 5, 2026 at 4:03 AM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Powerball numbers for Monday's drawing The winning Powerball numbers in the Wednesday, Nov. 4, drawing for the $847 million jackpot are 15, 56, 34, 53,41 and the Powerball is 21.
 The cash value is $357.9 million.
 Numbers are drawn at 10:59 p.m. Monday, Wednesday and Saturday. The next drawing is Saturday.
 Powerball tickets are $2 per play, and in Michigan, players can buy tickets up to 9:45 p.m. for the night of the drawing.
